content.comment_body: Hello. I have a project where I need to develop a program that monitors the temperature of a solar collector and keeps track of the maximum temperature recorded. Essentially, I need to continuously compare the current temperature with the stored highest value, updating it whenever a new maximum is detected. Ideally, I should also be able to output or display the highest temperature reached. I'm struggling to find a solution and would appreciate any assistance. Thanks in advance.
Hi, You may want to check some example projects at [url]. There is an example titled "Storing analog min/max values" that could be relevant to your task.
